chapter_name: Grassroots Democracy - Part 2: Local Government in Rural Areas
learning_objective: 🎯 Let's climb the three steps of the Panchayati Raj ladder and see how groups of villages work together to bring big changes!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The Gram Sabha is like a giant village meeting! Every adult in the village who can vote is a member. They gather to check the work of the Gram Panchayat and make sure money is spent wisely.

Rural government has three levels like a ladder. The Gram Panchayat is at the bottom for one village. The Block Samiti is in the middle for a group of villages. The Zila Parishad is at the very top for the whole district!
These three levels work together to solve big problems that a single village cannot fix alone, like building large hospitals, long roads, and big water tanks for everyone.

fun_activity.title: 🪜 The Power Pyramid
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big triangle on a piece of paper and divide it into three levels. Write 'Gram Panchayat' at the bottom, 'Block Samiti' in the middle, and 'Zila Parishad' at the top to remember the Panchayati Raj ladder!

quick_recap: ⭐ The Gram Sabha is an important meeting of all the adults in a village.
⭐ The Panchayati Raj is a three-tier system of local government in rural areas.
⭐ The Zila Parishad works at the district level to help all the blocks and villages below it.
